items.en: EU and other nations condemn settler attacks in the West Bank, targeting European diplomats.

items.en: Pakistan, Egypt foreign ministers condemn Houthi attacks, reaffirm Saudi solidarity.

items.en: Russia's Foreign Minister Lavrov commented on the Middle East situation.

items.en: Israeli forces set up military checkpoints at Bethlehem entrances.
